sentences.text: House of Balloons is the debut mixtape by Canadian singer The Weeknd .	The Weeknd	The Weeknd	mixtape	mixtape
It was released as a free download on March 21 , 2011 , by XO .	XO	XO (record label)
The mixtape was also released on his official website .	mixtape	mixtape

Its music incorporates electronic and urban genres , including R&B and soul , along with trip hop , indie rock and dream pop tones .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	soul	Soul music	trip hop	trip hop	indie rock	indie rock	dream pop	dream pop

The contributions to the mixtape 's production came from Canadian record producers such as Doc McKinney , Zodiac and Illangelo , among others .	Doc McKinney	Doc McKinney	Illangelo	Illangelo	mixtape	mixtape
In September 2013 , The Weeknd revealed that the House of Balloons is a real place , located at 65 Spencer Ave in Toronto .	The Weeknd	The Weeknd	Toronto	Toronto
